caption: After the import our two test contacts sat in the contact list with their accented names intact, next to the one sample contact; the trial counter shows 30 days left.
Before you upload, the importer lists its rules: CSV or XLS only, one fixed date format, up to 10000 records at a time, and special characters in first and last names are removed.
Most columns stay on Don't Import This Column until you map them by hand; we sent our test note to Contact Note and the email to Contact Email Address.
Getting the data out takes three clicks: select the contacts, tick the fields you want (here all of them) and click Export to CSV.
